Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: model theory | ID: 58965

Result

Let H be a complex manifold. Every stationary operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Proof

Step 3. By the subharmonic spectral theorem, we decompose \(Q_{01330013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the subharmonic spectral family.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the complex convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).
